channel.title: Mutex Studio blog
channel.description: Practical articles on Azure cost and autoscaling, Kubernetes ingress with Traefik, and file storage usage.

item.title: Azure SQL elastic pool sizing: per-database limits and scaling
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: When an Azure SQL elastic pool beats single databases, how to size it from real metrics, what per-database min and max settings do, and how to scale it.

item.title: Traefik CrowdSec on Kubernetes: bouncer plugin and AppSec
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: How to run CrowdSec with Traefik on Kubernetes: Helm install, Traefik access log parsing, the bouncer plugin as a Middleware, AppSec and real client IPs on AKS.

item.title: SharePoint storage usage: find what fills your tenant quota
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: How SharePoint storage usage is counted, which built-in reports to check, and PnP PowerShell scripts to find large sites, libraries, versions and recycle bins.

item.title: Azure SQL serverless vs provisioned: working out which costs less
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: How Azure SQL serverless and provisioned compute are billed, how to work out the break-even for a database, and where scheduled scaling or elastic pools fit.

item.title: Azure SQL scaling downtime: what happens and how to retry
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: What happens inside an Azure SQL Database scale operation, how long it takes, which errors your code should retry, and how to scale and monitor it safely.

item.title: Azure Blob Storage cost: where the bill comes from
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: A breakdown of Azure Blob Storage cost by meter: capacity per tier, transactions, retrieval, early deletion, versions and snapshots, and how to see each one.

item.title: Ingress-NGINX retirement on AKS: your migration options
item.dc:creator: David García García
item.description: What the ingress-nginx retirement means on AKS, how to inventory what you use, and why we move to Traefik rather than Application Gateway for Containers.
